subject: Shiny Developer Conference | Stanford University | January 2016

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Shiny Developer Conference | Stanford University | January 2016
parts:
Hi shiny-discuss members,

I just wanted to make sure you have seen the announcement this morning that we are holding our first ever Shiny Developer Conference! You can see the tentative lineup of talks and speakers, and register, at the Eventbrite page: http://shiny2016.eventbrite.com

We opened up registration this morning, and as of this writing we are down to 30 spots remaining. So I encourage you to register quickly if you are interested in attending!

Thanks, I look forward to meeting some of you in person in January!

-joe

messages.subject: Re: Shiny Developer Conference | Stanford University | January 2016
parts:
Thank you everyone for the response, it was quite a surprise to us to see how quickly we sold out! I'm very sorry we are not able to accommodate everyone who wanted to come.

We're going to focus on doing the Stanford conference first and learning all we can from that. But if all goes well and people find the conference useful, I don't know why we wouldn't do this again in other locations.
